{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv("/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv")

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) and refunded orders
df_filtered = df[(df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check for imbalance in customer_segment across channels
segment_channel_cross = pd.crosstab(df_filtered['channel'], df_filtered['customer_segment'])
print(f'Cross-tabulation of channel and customer_segment after filtering:\n{segment_channel_cross}')

# Compute average revenue per order by channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = df_filtered.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f'\nAverage revenue per order by channel:\n{avg_revenue_by_channel}')

# Compute conversion rate by channel
conversion_rate_by_channel = df_filtered.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print(f'\nConversion rate by channel:\n{conversion_rate_by_channel}')"}
